## Summary

Give each Projection a stable ID

## Claim

### Prose Claim


Projection identity across rebuilds.


Every Projection has one Projection ID. The same Projection Type, named source selection and source of truth identify the same Projection and keep the same ID across rebuilds.

## Details

- A different Type, named source selection or source of truth identifies a different Projection and requires a different ID.
- Changes to source contents, source Versions, the artifacts selected by the same selection, generated content or Updated At do not change the Projection ID.
- A change to the current Scope Unit name or Carrier path alone does not change the Projection ID.
- Projection ID identifies the derived view, not any source Atom. It does not make the Projection authoritative.

## Summary

Give each Projection a stable ID

## Claim

### Prose Claim


Projection identity across rebuilds.


Every Projection has one Projection ID. Its Form and Scope Unit determine its ID, and its ID determines its Form and Scope Unit. Rebuilding the same Projection retains that ID.

## Details

- A different Form or Scope Unit identifies a different Projection and requires a different ID.
- Changes to the Named Selection, its selected sources, source contents or Versions, generated content or Updated At do not change the Projection ID. Source.Named Selection describes the sources; it is not an identity component. Where Source.Atoms is recorded, each value identifies an Atom with its explicit Version.
- A change to the current Scope Unit name or Carrier path alone does not change the Projection ID.
- Projection ID identifies the derived view, not any source Atom. It does not make the Projection authoritative.

## Summary

Serialize Projection identity and filenames

## Claim

### Prose Claim


Projection Markdown File Carriers.


Use this filename:

`<PROJECT_PREFIX>-PROJ-<ID>-<CURRENT_SCOPE_NAME>--<PROJECTION_TYPE>--<NAMED_SELECTION>.md`

Store the full Projection ID as `projection_id` in YAML frontmatter. The filename and frontmatter must identify the same Projection.

## Details

For this Project, the prefix is `CA`. For example:

`CA-PROJ-001-CORE_META_MODEL--Entities-Graph--Current-Atoms.md`

Its full Projection ID is `CA-PROJ-001`; `001` is the ID segment in the filename. Use the current Scope Unit name, not its label.

The YAML frontmatter carries:

- `artifact_form: Projection`
- `projection_id`: the full Projection ID.
- `type`: Projection Type.
- `named_selection`: the named source selection.
- `source_of_truth`: an unambiguous reference to the authoritative source set.
- `updated_at`: the latest completed rebuild time under CA-D-310.
- `sources`: contributing Atom references with Versions, such as `CA-R-123@3`. Identify contributing non-Atom sources separately; do not invent Atom IDs for them.

Keep the ID under CA-R-1943 when rebuilding or changing only the Scope Unit name or Carrier path. Filename changes do not by themselves create a new Projection.

Type-specific Delivery rules define the body and any additional source evidence. Store the Carrier under the applicable Projection root under CA-D-550.
